about: Live day 4 (2026-11-10, the v1.2 release gates): the 215 postings pooled that day and the 492 distinct discarded titles (dropped at G4, G9 or G7, not for place or age) that a widened bioprocess title scan matched, each labeled for a second kind of user by the question 'could this person, casting a wide net, plausibly be hired for it at the level they target?'. The person: a bioprocess scientist (upstream and downstream process development, tech transfer and MSAT in cGMP biologics and viral vectors, a few industry years, most recently at senior scientist level with lab operations duties) with a microbiology doctorate and earlier years running a university lab. They target scientist II to senior and principal-adjacent roles, senior process engineer, MSAT, and lab operations or manufacturing sciences management; take contract but not temporary or part-time work; and rank shift work last. Pay is not part of the label. tier (yes only): core = their field and its neighbours (process development, MSAT, GMP manufacturing, manufacturing-side quality and validation, CMC, lab operations, viral vector and cell culture science, microbiology); wide = outside it but a plausible hire with overlapping methods. Entry roles in the field are yes (the pay floor, not the title, decides them); operator-level and lab-assistant roles, clinical research coordination, medical affairs and other careers are no. Fields: group (pool or discard), company, title and location as the boards published them (ASCII), family (the day's family for pooled items), was (the gate that dropped a discard that day), label, tier, reason, pay ([low, high] the posting's stated pay as yearly dollars, hourly rates at 2,080 hours; absent when it states none or its text was not read), text ('read' for a discard whose posting was read again on 2026-11-11), and after_text (what the round 6 gates did with the full text for a user profile of this kind and no pay floor: kept, or the gate and reason). No posting text, links or personal data.
